sources.title: Cribl detect: AI SIEM for modern security challenges
sources.snippet: Cribl Detect offers a cost-effective, adaptable AI SIEM for modern security operations challenges. AI-powered Cribl Detect enhances threat detection beyond traditional rules-based systems, reducing response times. Cribl Detect integrates with existing telemetry, preventing data silos and improving security efficiency.
